subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should the existing opt-in `logging.consoleStyle: "json"` contract intentionally include early CLI and direct stderr diagnostics, not only ordinary subsystem logging paths?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and preserves explicit command-result JSON, but it changes what existing JSON-console users receive across additional command routes; that output-contract scope is a maintainer choice.

options.title: Accept the expanded opt-in contract
options.body: Merge the shared capture and diagnostic formatting path as the completion of JSONL console output for operators who selected JSON console style.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Keep JSON formatting limited to the previously documented logging paths and redesign the early CLI diagnostic behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the expanded opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Merge the shared capture and diagnostic formatting path as the completion of JSONL console output for operators who selected JSON console style.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch integrates the affected CLI and logging boundaries and is the most direct routing contact for this merge-scope decision.
